attributes.title: NASW-FL 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Florida Chapter
attributes.summary:
The Florida Chapter of NASW holds its 2027 annual conference April 12 to 14, 2027, at the Florida Hotel and Conference Center in Orlando. The chapter says the meeting draws more than 400 social workers and mental health professionals from Florida and beyond.

The call for proposals asked for the workshops Florida social workers need for license renewal (domestic violence, ethics and telehealth, laws and rules update, and clinical supervision update), plus tracks on clinical innovations, emerging issues, policy and advocacy, and a student showcase. Final CE hours, the program and registration fees are not published yet; the chapter says registration opens in 2027.

The conference hotel offers a $140 group rate with a cutoff of March 26, 2027.
